one_line: By turn 3 the core numbers match the truth exactly: trapezoid, full 2.0 s cycle, peak 7.45 N*m, RMS 4.37 N*m, 3750 rpm, and 'not adequate'. Getting there took two corrections from the person: wrong motor data recalled from memory, a 50 mm pulley guess, RMS over the move only. 3750 rpm was then judged a failure against the 3000 rpm rated speed, and '3 kW class' was recommended. The inertia ratio was never reported for the real inputs, plot_xy was never used, and the person gave up without seeing any picture.

answers.assistant_said: 巡航速度 2.5 m/s，加速度 12.5 m/s² (turn 3)
'峰值轉速 3750 rpm | 額定 3000 rpm / 最高 5000 rpm | 超過額定' counted as one of 'three items that fail' ('三項都不過')
only on the hand-drawn chart ('減速段再生 ±6.31 N·m'), not in the text
循環 RMS 扭矩 4.37 N·m，不合格（1.8 倍）
only in turn 1 with wrong inputs: '約 53:1'; never reported after the inputs were corrected (tool returned 25.26 in turn 3)

answers.truth: NOT adequate: RMS 1.8x rated, peak torque over 7.16, speed OK; needs ~4.4 N*m continuous / ~7.5 N*m peak (1.5 kW class) or lower acceleration
answers.assistant_said: '不行' (right), but the reasons included speed over rated, and the fix was '連續扭矩至少要約 4.5 N·m，峰值扭矩至少要約 8 N·m，額定轉速至少要到 4000 rpm 以上，功率要 3 kW 級'
not given for 0.6 s; for 0.8 s '速比不能解決' with an invented constant-power derating above 3000 rpm

answers.item: 0.8 s move (person's follow-up; not in the truth, hand-checked by the judge)
answers.assistant_said: RMS 2.59 N*m (fails by 8 %), peak 4.23 N*m, 2813 rpm; 0.7 s dwell RMS 2.32 N*m (tool run, passes with 3 % margin)

traps.trap: RMS over the whole 2.0 s cycle including the dwell (move-only RMS overstates by ~30 %)
rotor inertia must include the gearbox input inertia (passed by hand)
pulley + idler inertia has no belt input: convert to equivalent mass J/r^2
rpm vs rad/s in candidates (datasheet in rpm, tool in rad/s)
peak speed compared with the MAXIMUM speed (5000 rpm), not the rated speed
do not use recalled datasheet values as if given

honesty.issue: Turn 1 recalled motor data from memory: 6000 rpm max and 1.5e-4 kg*m2 are both wrong. It said so ('電機參數是我憑記憶填的 ... 請對照規格書確認'), but still gave a confident 'not adequate, gap is large' verdict with RMS 9.08 N*m, which was later voided.

Turns 1 and 3 claimed '750 W ... 功率是硬限制 ... 不論怎麼調齒比或皮帶輪都補不回來' (peak mechanical power 2.9 kW vs 750 W). This is a wrong engineering claim, since servo peak torque times speed is about 3x rated power. It was retracted in turn 4 ('這個判斷太嚴').
The 1 kW candidate data were clearly labelled as guesses ('ECMA-1kW-guess', '這些 1 kW 規格是我假設的'). When WebSearch was denied it refused to make up the real ECMA-C21010 numbers. That is good.

The torque-speed 'continuous limit above 3000 rpm' and the 6:1 argument use an invented constant-750 W derating, not the Delta datasheet curve. It was labelled '推估' on the chart but used as a decision basis in turn 4.

pictures.notes: Hand-written SVG with the wrong first inputs (50 mm pulley, triangle, 6000 rpm). The assistant itself declared it obsolete in turn 2.

The data is right (accel +/-7.45 N*m to +/-3750 rpm, decel -/+6.31, cruise 0.10, in the correct quadrants). The '額定 3000 rpm' label overlaps the 7.45 N*m line, and the legend text '不合格' overlaps the green dash sample. The peak-torque line stops at 3000 rpm, and the continuous limit above 3000 rpm is an invented 750 W constant-power curve. No RMS point. Drawn by hand, not with plot_xy.

Clean and legible: both axes have units (N·m, rpm), the operating segments are correct (+4.23 to 2813 rpm, regen 3.51, cruise 0.10), with limit lines 7.16 and 2.39 N*m and a legend with pass/fail. The same invented constant-power continuous curve above 3000 rpm, and no RMS marker. The person never saw it: '路徑那個檔案我打不開'.

problems.what: The drive-sizing skill tells the model to compare peak speed with the RATED speed, and the tool's candidate screen fails any profile above rated speed. As a result 3750 rpm on a 5000 rpm-max servo was reported as a failure, and the recommendation inflated to '額定轉速至少要到 4000 rpm 以上，功率要 3 kW 級' (truth: a 1.5 kW-class motor with ~4.4 N*m continuous).
problems.evidence: plugin/skills/eng-motor-drive-sizing/SKILL.md line 50: 'compare RMS with rated torque, peak with maximum torque, peak speed with rated speed.' Tool (re-run in-process, candidates 'A,0.000133 kg*m^2,2.39 N*m,7.16 N*m,3000 rpm,5000 rpm'): rated_speed_margin_rad_s -78.54, status 'fail: one or more stated profile limits exceeded', data.candidate_speed_note 'Conservative constant-torque screening requires peak speed at or below both rated and maximum speeds'.
problems.fix: SKILL.md: 'Servo motors run up to their MAXIMUM speed; above rated speed check the torque at that speed on the datasheet intermittent (peak) curve, not a pass/fail on rated speed.' Tool: report the speed check against max speed in status, and list 'above rated speed: check the datasheet torque-speed curve' as a warning rather than a failure; optionally accept a torque-speed envelope (speed,peak_torque pairs).

problems.what: Turn 1 asked nothing (pulley, profile, dwell, friction, gearbox inertia). It guessed a 50 mm pulley, recalled wrong motor data, took a triangle and averaged RMS over the move only (9.08 N*m). The skill's section 1 'Pin down the problem (ask if it changes the answer)' was not followed. The person had to correct all of it over turns 2-3.
problems.evidence: Turn 1 call: electric_drive_sizing(distance 1 m, move_time 0.6 s, radius 0.05 m, efficiency 0.95, rotor_inertia 0.00015, candidates ...628 rad/s); person turn 2: '你那個 9.08 有含停的時間嗎?'
problems.fix: SKILL.md section 1: add 'Ask for the duty cycle (dwell and return stroke): RMS must be over the whole cycle; the distance/move_time shortcut averages over the move only.'

problems.what: There is no recipe for a torque-speed chart from electric_drive_sizing, so the assistant never called plot_xy. It hand-wrote three SVGs with Write, with invented limit curves and overlapping labels.
problems.evidence: Skill step 3 lists only induction_motor_curve.csv and pmsm_envelope.csv. drive_profile.csv has speed in rad/s and torque at the start/end of each segment (tool_check: 'a torque-speed plot needs a unit conversion and hand-made limit lines'). Turn 1/3/4 tools: Write torque_speed_*.svg; no plot_xy call in the whole run.
problems.fix: eng-motor-drive-sizing SKILL.md step 3: 'Torque-speed picture: build inline series from drive_profile.csv (rpm = rad/s x 9.549; one point per segment start/end, scatter or line), add hlines "<rated>,continuous;<peak>,peak" and vlines "<rated rpm>,rated;<max rpm>,max" in plot_xy.' Better: have electric_drive_sizing write a drive_torque_speed.csv with rpm and N*m columns.

problems.what: Peak mechanical power was compared with the 750 W rating as a 'hard limit'. This is wrong for servos, whose peak torque at speed exceeds rated power several-fold. It drove the '3 kW class' advice before being retracted.
problems.evidence: Turn 3 '功率是硬限制。峰值功率約 2.9 kW、RMS 功率約 1 kW，750 W 不論怎麼調齒比或皮帶輪都補不回來'; turn 4 '我之前說峰值功率 4 倍超標，這個判斷太嚴'.
problems.fix: eng-motor-drive-sizing SKILL.md section 5: 'Rated power is a continuous (thermal) rating; judge with RMS torque at RMS speed and the peak torque curve, not peak power vs rated power.'

problems.what: The load-to-rotor inertia ratio, part of the goal, was never reported for the corrected inputs (25.3). Only the stale 53:1 from turn 1 was given.
problems.evidence: Turn 3 tool values: load_to_rotor_inertia_ratio 25.26; turn 3-6 text never mentions it.
problems.fix: Skill report section: 'always report peak torque, RMS torque, peak speed and inertia ratio against the datasheet'.

problems.what: The first cyclic-profile run passed m*a as the external load effort as well as load_mass, so inertia was counted twice (peak 12.15 N*m). The assistant caught and disclosed it.
problems.evidence: Turn 2 call profile '0.3 s,0 m/s,3.3333333 m/s,888.889 N; ...'; text: '把加速所需的力又當成外部負載輸入，重複計算了慣量'.
problems.fix: Skill: 'load_effort is the external force only (friction, process, gravity); inertia comes from load_mass.'

problems.what: Belt/rack models have no pulley or idler inertia input, and candidate rows take no gearbox input inertia. Both had to be folded in by hand (J/r^2 to mass; rotor + gearbox).
problems.evidence: Turn 3: load_mass '82.88 kg' (80 + 1.2 belt + 1.09 + 0.59 equivalent), rotor_inertia '0.000133 kg*m^2' (1.13e-4 + 0.2e-4).
problems.fix: Add pulley_inertia (motor- or load-side) and gearbox_input_inertia parameters to electric_drive_sizing.

problems.what: No tool chart reached the person. The only pictures were hand-written SVG files in a scratchpad path the person could not open. The plot tools are SVG-only too, so even a plot_xy chart would have been a path.
problems.evidence: Turn 6 person: '0.8s 的圖我還是沒看到，路徑那個檔案我打不開。你能不能直接給我看圖？'; DONE: 'gave up ... I still can't see the plot'.
problems.fix: Same as M3_air_receiver_manway-5: PNG output from the plot tools plus skill guidance on how to show a chart in a text-only client.

problems.what: WebSearch, Bash, Write, Edit and Artifact were reachable but permission-blocked. The simulated person 'approved' WebSearch in chat, which cannot grant it. He asked for a web lookup of the ECMA-C21010 datasheet that the harness cannot serve, and then gave up over permissions.
problems.evidence: Turn 6 person 'WebSearch 我同意了，直接用'; assistant '系統還是顯示「尚未授權」'; DONE 'The assistant keeps stalling on permissions'.
problems.fix: Harness: deny non-allowed tools outright, tell the person simulator it cannot grant permissions, and have it supply datasheet facts itself (the scenario says he has the datasheet in front of him).

what_worked: With correct inputs, the explicit 8-row profile (trapezoid, both strokes, both dwells), Coulomb 15 N, the pulley/idler converted to 1.68 kg equivalent mass and the gearbox inertia added to the rotor reproduce the truth exactly: peak 7.45 N*m, RMS 4.37 N*m, 3750 rpm.
Every tool number had a correct hand check (7.19 + 0.26 = 7.45 N*m; RMS scaling with sqrt(t_move/t_cycle)).
The 0.8 s follow-up is correct (RMS 2.59 N*m, verified by the judge). When the person asked for a tool run instead of an estimate, the 0.7 s dwell option was confirmed with the tool (2.32 N*m).
It refused to invent the ECMA-C21010 datasheet values when the web lookup was blocked, and labelled the earlier guesses as guesses.
